title: Wildlife and Fisheries Science, Minor (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: 22cr bulletin nominal, computed 26cr. Distinct from the already-built Wildlife and Fisheries Science major (code WFS) -- code WFSMIN to avoid collision. Prescribed BIOL 110 (4cr) + WFS 209N (3cr) + WFS 430 (3cr). Real hidden-prereq gap: WFS 430 needs BIOL 220W, not otherwise part of this minor -- added explicitly (BIOL 220W's own only prereq is BIOL 110, already prescribed here, so the chain closes with one course). 12cr elective pool filled with four prereq-clean picks from the bulletin's own list (WFS 447W and WFS 462, both prereq-free; WFS 422 and WFS 460, both needing only BIOL 110, already prescribed) -- WFS 463W was avoided since it needs WFS 300/301/310, none otherwise in this minor. Landing at 26cr (10 prescribed + 4 hidden-prereq + 12 elective) against the bulletin's 22cr nominal, same documented-not-absorbed convention as CHEMMIN/ASTROMIN/NUTRMIN's own hidden-prereq additions.
